summary: Twenty weekday revenue experiments for one existing Gumroad product through one dedicated company-owned Bluesky promotional account.

goal.title: Test whether one existing product can sustain at least five dollars in daily gross revenue
goal.description: Run one measurable, bounded company-owned Bluesky distribution experiment per Phoenix weekday for no more than 20 run-days while enforcing a 100 dollar total AI ceiling, a 5 dollar daily AI ceiling including reserve, explicit checkpoints, and an unconditional stop.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the baseline direct-offer experiment
roadmap_items.description: Create and publish one concise post on the dedicated company-owned Bluesky account that names the freelancer cold-email problem, presents the existing Starter Pack, links only to the approved Gumroad product, and establishes the baseline offer angle. Use the allowlisted campaign publish action exactly once.
acceptance_criteria: The post targets freelancers who need to win client work without sounding spammy.
The post contains one clear problem, one concrete product benefit, and one call to action using only the approved Gumroad URL.
The publish action targets bluesky:freelanceremailkit.bsky.social exactly once and returns a persisted provider receipt or a terminal blocked result.
The run records the pre-action and post-action Gumroad revenue snapshots without inventing engagement or sales data.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the blank-page pain experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one company-owned Bluesky post centered on the blank-page cost of writing cold outreach from scratch, with a concrete example of how the existing product shortens that work. Use the approved product and channel only.
acceptance_criteria: The post leads with one recognizable freelancer pain and avoids unsupported performance claims.
The copy includes one useful takeaway even if the reader does not buy.
The approved Gumroad URL is the only sales destination and the publish action occurs at most once.
The experiment and provider outcome are persisted for comparison with later days.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the useful-template excerpt experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one genuinely useful, short excerpt or framework from the existing Starter Pack and invite readers who want the complete system to view the approved Gumroad product.
acceptance_criteria: The post gives a complete actionable excerpt rather than teasing unavailable value.
The excerpt does not expose the entire paid product and makes no fabricated claim about results.
The approved Gumroad URL is used once and no other channel or product is promoted.
The publish receipt and revenue snapshots are persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the builder-story experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one transparent builder-story post explaining why the product exists, who it is for, and what is actually included. Do not invent customer stories, testimonials, or sales evidence.
acceptance_criteria: The post distinguishes verified product contents from unverified market outcomes.
The story stays relevant to the target freelancer's client-acquisition problem.
Only the approved product and channel are used, with one publish attempt.
The action result and revenue evidence are persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the first objection experiment and reach checkpoint one
roadmap_items.description: Publish one post answering the strongest evidenced objection from the first four experiments. After the action, the controller must evaluate the day-5 meaningful-interest checkpoint and either continue with evidence or mark a pivot required without requesting more AI work that day.
acceptance_criteria: The selected objection is grounded in recorded campaign evidence or explicitly labeled as the initial hypothesis.
The post answers the objection without discounts, fake urgency, or unsupported proof.
One approved publish action is attempted and its outcome is persisted.
The day-5 checkpoint records continue or pivot_required from actual revenue or provider-reported interaction signals.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the checkpoint-driven angle experiment
roadmap_items.description: If checkpoint one passed, publish a sharper version of the best evidenced angle. If a pivot is required, change exactly one major variable: target pain, proof format, or call to action. State which variable changed in the experiment record.
acceptance_criteria: The experiment names the single changed variable and the evidence that justified it.
All other major offer variables remain stable enough for a useful comparison.
The approved channel and product are used in no more than one publish action.
The pivot or continuation rationale and provider outcome are persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the subject-line framework experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one compact subject-line framework drawn from the product, then connect it to the complete Starter Pack with the approved link.
acceptance_criteria: The post teaches a usable subject-line framework with at least one concrete example.
It avoids guarantees about open, reply, or conversion rates.
Exactly one approved publish action is attempted.
The provider outcome and revenue snapshots are persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the before-and-after message experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one before-and-after cold-email example showing a weak pattern and an improved pattern without claiming empirical results that are not recorded.
acceptance_criteria: The before-and-after example is concrete, concise, and useful on its own.
The improvement rationale is explained without fabricated conversion evidence.
The approved Gumroad destination is used and publish is attempted at most once.
The experiment outcome is persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the quality-not-volume experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one value-first post about respectful, low-volume outreach and explain how the product supports quality rather than spam.
acceptance_criteria: The post explicitly discourages indiscriminate bulk outreach.
It gives one practical quality control a freelancer can apply immediately.
Only the approved product and channel are used in one publish attempt.
The provider outcome and revenue evidence are persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the personalization checklist experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one short personalization checklist for freelancers and position the Starter Pack as the reusable foundation beneath genuine research.
acceptance_criteria: The checklist has three to five specific checks and does not encourage deceptive personalization.
The product positioning remains consistent with its verified contents.
One approved publish action is attempted with the approved product link.
The action result and revenue snapshots are persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the workflow demonstration experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one step-by-step mini workflow showing how a freelancer can move from prospect research to a tailored first message using the existing product as a starting system.
acceptance_criteria: The workflow contains a clear sequence and one practical example.
It preserves human research and judgment rather than promising push-button outcomes.
The post uses only the approved link and one publish attempt.
The experiment outcome is persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the generic-template objection experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one post addressing the objection that templates sound generic. Demonstrate how one approved template can be adapted while preserving authenticity.
acceptance_criteria: The post includes one generic-to-specific transformation.
The example does not disclose private prospect data or invent a customer result.
Exactly one approved publish action is attempted.
The provider result and revenue evidence are persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the follow-up sequence experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one concise framework for respectful follow-up timing and explain which follow-up resources the existing Starter Pack includes.
acceptance_criteria: The framework sets a bounded, respectful follow-up cadence and an explicit stop condition.
The product contents are described accurately without performance guarantees.
One approved publish action is attempted.
The outcome is persisted for campaign comparison.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the reply-handling experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one practical reply-handling example from the product for a common positive or hesitant prospect response, then connect it to the complete resource.
acceptance_criteria: The post includes one useful reply script and explains when to use it.
It avoids manipulative language and fabricated buyer dialogue.
Only the approved product and one publish action are used.
The provider outcome and revenue snapshots are persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the strongest evidenced offer and reach checkpoint two
roadmap_items.description: Publish one direct offer using the strongest angle supported by the prior 14 run records. After the action, the controller must stop the campaign unless at least one sale or one strong-intent signal has been recorded.
acceptance_criteria: The chosen angle cites persisted campaign evidence and does not invent social proof.
The call to action is direct, accurate, and limited to the approved Gumroad product.
One approved publish action is attempted and persisted.
The day-15 checkpoint records continue or a terminal no_sale_or_strong_intent stop without another model call.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the value-stack experiment
roadmap_items.description: If checkpoint two passed, publish one post that clearly enumerates the verified resources in the Starter Pack and the freelancer work each resource replaces or improves.
acceptance_criteria: Every listed component is verified against the existing product contents.
The value explanation avoids invented time savings or revenue claims.
One approved publish action is attempted with the approved product link.
The provider result and revenue snapshots are persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the risk-reversal experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one transparent post that reduces uncertainty by showing exactly what buyers receive and who should not buy, without inventing guarantees, scarcity, or refund promises.
acceptance_criteria: The post names both the intended buyer and a clear not-for-you case.
Every product statement is verifiable and no policy or guarantee is invented.
The approved publish action occurs at most once.
The outcome is persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the evidence-transparency experiment
roadmap_items.description: Publish one post that truthfully summarizes what the campaign has learned so far, including uncertainty, then offers the product using the best evidenced message.
acceptance_criteria: The post uses only persisted campaign evidence and clearly labels uncertainty.
It does not expose private data, internal costs, credentials, or provider receipts.
One approved publish action is attempted with the approved product link.
The action outcome and revenue evidence are persisted.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the best-angle retest
roadmap_items.description: Retest the best evidenced angle with one deliberate copy variation while holding the product, channel, and offer stable.
acceptance_criteria: The experiment identifies the winning prior angle and exactly one new copy variable.
The product, channel, destination, and core offer remain unchanged.
Exactly one approved publish action is attempted.
The provider outcome and revenue snapshots are persisted for final comparison.

roadmap_items.title: Publish the final direct-offer experiment and close the sprint
roadmap_items.description: Publish one final direct offer using the best persisted evidence, then record the economic closeout. The controller must stop the sprint after this run regardless of outcome and must invoke no day-21 model.
acceptance_criteria: The final post uses the best evidenced positioning without fabricating proof or urgency.
One approved publish action is attempted and its outcome is persisted.
The closeout reports cumulative sales, gross revenue, campaign-attributed AI spend, observed contribution, and whether the five-dollar daily target was demonstrated.
The campaign enters a terminal state after day 20 and a later trigger performs no model or external action.
